products.name: 16-Symbol Quick Chart
products.shortDescription: Multi-symbol dashboard that monitors every trendline on your charts and alerts you when price touches support or resistance.
overview: 16-Symbol Quick Chart is a multi-symbol dashboard that watches the trendlines you have drawn on your charts and tells you the moment price reaches one of them. You do not need to name the lines or give them a special color. Every trendline is monitored automatically.

Each symbol gets its own card showing the symbol name, live price, current status and ATR. When price touches a trendline below the current price (support), the card turns green and a sound alert plays. When price touches a trendline above (resistance), the card turns red with an alert. The chart you are currently on is always highlighted in gold, so you never lose track of where you are.

Click any card and the chart switches to that symbol instantly. The tool comes with a ready list of popular instruments, including Gold, Silver, major Forex pairs, DJ30 and major cryptocurrencies, and the whole list is fully editable. The footer shows your live floating P/L and margin level.
features: 16 symbols on one compact dashboard
Monitors all trendlines automatically, no naming or color needed
Green alert when price touches support (line below price)
Red alert when price touches resistance (line above price)
Current chart card highlighted in gold
Live price, status and ATR on every card
Click any card to switch the chart instantly
Sound alerts with adjustable cooldown
Floating P/L and margin level in the footer
Pre-loaded symbols: XAUUSD, XAGUSD, majors, DJ30, BTC, ETH and more, all editable
requirements: The symbols must be available in your Market Watch

sections.title: How it works
items: Draw trendlines on the charts of the symbols you follow, in any color and with any name
The dashboard keeps watching those lines and compares them with live price
A line below price is treated as support and a line above price as resistance
When price touches a line, the card changes color and the sound alert plays
Click a card to open that symbol on your chart

The symbol list is fully editable, so you can replace the defaults with your own instruments
Every symbol you use must be visible in your Market Watch

products.name: Live Timeframe Candles
products.shortDescription: Multi-timeframe panel with live countdown timers, one-click timeframe switching and real-time mini candle previews.
overview: Live Timeframe Candles is a clean on-chart panel that puts every timeframe in one place. It lists all timeframes from M1 to Monthly and shows a live countdown for each one until its current candle closes, so you always know how long is left before a candle completes.

Click any timeframe button to switch the chart to it immediately. You can also toggle individual timeframes on to see a live mini-candle preview with real-time Open, High, Low and Close values, which gives you multi-timeframe awareness without opening extra charts. Optional chart styling gives the candles a cleaner look.
The panel is fast, lightweight and works on any broker and any symbol.
features: Full list of timeframes from M1 to Monthly
Live countdown timer until each candle closes
One-click switch to any timeframe
Toggleable live mini-candle previews with real-time OHLC
Optional chart candle styling

sections.title: Good for

products.name: TradingView Tools for MT5
products.shortDescription: Clean floating toolbar with TradingView-style drawing tools: trend lines, zones, FVG, order blocks, risk/reward, Fibonacci and measure.
overview: TradingView Tools for MT5 brings a clean, professional floating toolbar to MetaTrader 5, inspired by the drawing tools traders know from TradingView. The panel is fully draggable and can be minimized, so it stays out of the way when you do not need it.

Draw Trend Lines, Zones, Fair Value Gaps (FVG) and Order Blocks with one or two clicks. The Risk/Reward tool calculates correctly and its boxes are fully movable and resizable. You also get Fibonacci retracement levels and a Measure tool that shows pips, bars and percentage.
Magnet mode snaps your drawings precisely to candle highs and lows. Select, Delete and Clear All are always one click away, and colors and opacity can be customized for every tool.

products.name: SMC Map
products.shortDescription: Smart Money Concepts visualizer that draws unmitigated FVGs, Order Blocks and swing levels with a live info panel. It never places trades.
overview: SMC Map is a pure visualization tool for traders who use Smart Money Concepts (SMC / ICT-style analysis). It does not place any trades. It only draws and keeps updated the most important institutional zones and levels, so you can read market structure at a glance.

It is made for traders who already understand FVG, Order Blocks and market structure and want a clean, reliable visual layer that stays up to date automatically, without clutter or lag. No trading logic, no signals, no orders.

products.name: TF & Session Levels
products.shortDescription: Premium panel that draws the High and Low of M1 to Monthly candles and the Asia, Tokyo, London and New York session ranges. Visual only, no trading.
overview: TF & Session Levels draws the key levels most traders mark by hand: the High and Low of higher-timeframe candles and the High and Low of each trading session. Everything is controlled from a compact premium panel on your chart, where each item has its own ON/OFF toggle.

For 8 timeframes (M1, M5, M15, H1, H4, D1, W1 and MN1) it extends a High line and a Low line to the right of the chart, each timeframe in its own color, with a label showing the price. You can base the levels on the previous candle or on the current candle.

For 4 sessions (Asia, Tokyo, London and New York) it draws a box around each session's range for the last several days and shows the session High and Low. A live status bar in the panel header shows which sessions are open right now.
This tool is analysis only. It never places, modifies or closes any order.

products.name: Trade Quality Monitor
products.shortDescription: Analytics panel for your own trading: live spread, exposure, slippage, costs, performance stats, session breakdown and CSV export. Analysis only.
overview: Trade Quality Monitor is a scrollable analytics panel that shows how good your trading and your execution really are. It reads your account history and your open positions and turns them into clear numbers, all on the chart.

The panel is split into five sections: live market conditions, current exposure, execution and costs, performance of closed trades, and a breakdown by trading session. You can view Today, This week, This month or All history, and look at only the current symbol or at all symbols.
This tool NEVER places, modifies or closes any order. It is made for traders who want to measure and improve their own results, whether they trade manually or use other tools.

products.name: Alert Manager Panel
products.shortDescription: Nine alert types in one dashboard: price, candle close, spread, RSI, time and floating loss, with draggable chart lines and popup, sound, push and e-mail delivery.
overview: Alert Manager Panel is a full alert center for MetaTrader 5. Instead of the single price alert built into the terminal, it lets you create up to 30 alerts per chart from one collapsible dashboard and choose exactly what each alert watches: price crossing up or down, a candle closing above or below a level, the spread rising above a limit, RSI crossing a level on the timeframe you pick, a clock time, or your floating profit/loss falling to a loss amount.

Every price-based alert is drawn on the chart as a line that you can drag to a new level, and the alert follows the line. Each alert can fire once, repeat (with a cooldown so you are not spammed) or, for time alerts, repeat daily. When an alert triggers you can be notified by popup, sound, push notification and e-mail, and each channel is switched on or off with one button on the panel.

The panel validates what you enter (for example it warns if price is already above the level of a PRICE UP alert), keeps a list of active alerts with paging, a log of the last triggers, and pause / resume controls. Alerts are saved to disk and restored when you restart MetaTrader or change the timeframe. It is an analysis tool only and never places, modifies or closes trades.

products.name: Auto Structure & Fibonacci Panel
products.shortDescription: Automatic market structure with swing labels, BOS and CHoCH detection, plus an auto Fibonacci on the latest leg with golden pocket and extension targets.
overview: Auto Structure & Fibonacci Panel reads the price structure of any chart and marks it for you. It finds swing highs and lows using an adjustable swing strength, labels them HH, HL, LH and LL, and detects Break of Structure (BOS) and Change of Character (CHoCH) events, so you can see at a glance whether the market is in a bullish structure, a bearish structure or waiting for a break.

On the most recent leg between the last swing high and swing low, the tool automatically draws a Fibonacci retracement with the levels you choose, highlights the golden-pocket zone (0.618 to 0.786 by default) and can add extension targets such as -0.272, -0.618 and -1.0. The dashboard shows the latest swing high and low, the trend direction, the size of the leg, how far price has retraced and whether price is inside the pocket.

Every layer (swings, BOS/CHoCH, Fibonacci, extensions, pocket) has its own on/off button, and alerts notify you when a new BOS or CHoCH is confirmed or when price enters the golden pocket. It works on any symbol and timeframe and never trades.

products.name: Chart Analysis Panel
products.shortDescription: One dashboard for sessions, key levels, pivots, ADR, multi-timeframe trend and automatic supply and demand zones.
overview: Chart Analysis Panel collects the analysis most traders redo on every chart into one tool. It draws the Asia, London and New York sessions as boxes with the session high and low, plots the previous day, week and month levels together with the current opens, adds pivot points, projects the average daily range and shows the trend on four timeframes in a compact table.

The tool also scans the chart for supply and demand zones. It looks for strong impulse candles (body larger than a multiple of ATR), marks the origin of the move as a zone, and shows whether the zone is still fresh or has already been tested, including how many times. Zones are limited to the strongest few per type so the chart stays readable.

The dashboard shows the active session, the next session and a countdown to it, the time left until the current candle closes, the spread and how much of the daily range is already used. Every group of levels can be switched on or off from the panel. Session hours are fully adjustable to your broker's server time, and the tool never places or modifies any trade.

products.name: Discipline & Journal Panel
products.shortDescription: Pre-trade checklist, rule monitoring and an automatic trade journal with screenshots, ratings, statistics and CSV export.
overview: Discipline & Journal Panel is built for manual traders who want to trade by their rules. Before you enter, you tick off a customizable checklist of up to five items. While you trade, the panel watches your behavior against the limits you set: maximum trades per day, maximum losing streak, a cooldown after a loss, a mandatory stop loss within a grace period and the hours you are allowed to trade.

Every closed trade is logged automatically in a journal. The panel records entry and exit, profit, points, duration, session, weekday, risk and R-multiple, saves screenshots of the chart at open and at close, and lets you attach a tag (Breakout, Pullback, Reversal, Range, News, Other), a 1-5 star rating and a note. Trades that break a rule are flagged (no stop loss, overtrading, revenge trade, off-hours, no checklist).

The performance section shows win rate, profit factor, expectancy, streaks and net result for today, this week, this month or all time, plus a breakdown by session and weekday. Everything can be exported to CSV. The panel never opens trades. It records and warns, and only if you turn enforcement on will it close trades that break your rules.

products.name: Market Scanner Panel
products.shortDescription: Live watchlist of up to 40 symbols with price, daily change, spread, RSI, trend and ADR usage; sort, filter and jump to any chart with one click.
overview: Market Scanner Panel turns one chart into a market overview. You enter a list of symbols (or load everything from Market Watch) and the panel shows a live table with the price, the change since the previous daily close, the spread, the RSI, the EMA trend and how much of the average daily range (ADR) each symbol has already used.

You can sort the table by any column and switch the filter to show only symbols with extreme RSI, bullish trend, bearish trend or high ADR usage, which makes it quick to spot candidates. The RSI and trend timeframe can be changed from M5 to D1. With one click on a row you either open or focus a chart of that symbol or switch the current chart to it, depending on the mode you choose.

Optional alerts notify you when a symbol reaches an RSI extreme or uses 100% of its ADR. The watchlist is saved between sessions, supports broker symbol suffixes, and the tool never places or modifies any trade.

products.name: News Calendar & Filter Panel
products.shortDescription: Built-in MT5 economic calendar with countdown, impact and currency filters, news lines, pre-news alerts and optional news protection.
overview: News Calendar & Filter Panel brings the MetaTrader 5 economic calendar onto your chart without any external service or website. It shows the next event with a live countdown, its forecast, previous value and impact, followed by a list of the upcoming events that match your filter.

You choose the minimum impact (all, medium and above, or high only) and whether to follow the currencies of the current symbol automatically, add extra currencies, or show all currencies. Event times can be shown in server time or in your PC's local time, with an optional manual time shift. Vertical lines mark the events on the chart.

The dashboard status tells you whether the market is CLEAR, in a CAUTION period or in a NO-TRADE window around a news release. Alerts warn you before the news (for example 30, 10 and 1 minutes before) and when it is released, including the actual value compared with the forecast. Optional protection features can close trades opened inside the news window and close positions and delete pending orders a few minutes before news. They are OFF by default, and the tool never opens trades. The calendar is not available in the Strategy Tester.

products.name: Quick Trade Panel
products.shortDescription: One-click BUY / SELL with risk-based lot sizing, SL/TP in points, partial close, break-even, trailing stop, reverse and bulk close tools.
overview: Quick Trade Panel is a fast execution and position management panel for manual traders. The ORDER SETTINGS section lets you choose between a fixed lot and a risk percentage of your balance. In risk mode the panel calculates the lot from your stop loss in points and shows the lot size and spread before you click, so every trade is sized correctly.

The POSITION MANAGEMENT section handles everything after entry. You can close part of your positions with one click (10%, 25%, 50%, 75% or 90%), move to break-even with an offset, switch on a trailing stop with a distance and step, reverse positions, or close by group: all, only BUYs, only SELLs, only profitable or only losing positions. CLOSE ALL asks for confirmation if you keep that option on.

The panel checks the basics for you (AutoTrading status, free margin, minimum stop distance, trading allowed for the symbol) and shows clear messages. It never opens a trade by itself; every action is triggered by your click.

products.name: Risk Manager Panel
products.shortDescription: Capital protection dashboard with daily loss limit, max drawdown, profit target, open-risk monitor, position size calculator and optional auto-close lock.
overview: Risk Manager Panel protects your account while you trade manually. It tracks your daily loss limit against the equity at the start of the trading day, your maximum total drawdown and your profit target against the initial balance, and shows how much of each limit you have already used with clear status banners: SAFE, WARNING, LIMIT HIT and TRADING LOCKED.

The OPEN RISK & ACTIVITY section monitors the risk to stop loss of your open positions, the number of open positions and the number of trades opened today, with optional caps for each, plus a warning when a position has no stop loss or exceeds your maximum risk per trade. A built-in position size calculator gives you the lot for your risk percentage and stop loss in points.

If you turn auto-close on, the panel closes positions and locks trading when a limit is hit; with it off, you only get alerts. An override button lets you unlock until the next trading day when you decide to. State is saved between sessions and the daily limit resets automatically at your chosen day-start hour. The panel never opens trades.

products.name: Telegram Notifier Panel
products.shortDescription: Sends trade, order, account and report notifications to Telegram with chart screenshots, and answers /status, /positions and /today commands.
overview: Telegram Notifier Panel keeps you informed about your MetaTrader 5 account on your phone. It sends a formatted Telegram message when a trade is opened, closed, partially closed or modified, when a pending order is placed, filled, cancelled or expired, and when your account needs attention. Messages include the symbol, direction, volume, entry, SL, TP, risk, RR, exit, net result and duration.

It also sends an automatic daily report and a weekly report at the time you choose, and warns you about low margin level, daily drawdown and floating loss. Chart screenshots can be attached when a trade opens or sent on demand. You can query your terminal from Telegram with the commands /status, /positions, /today, /week, /ping and /help.

A message queue with automatic retries makes delivery reliable, and an activity log on the panel shows what was sent. Each event type can be switched on or off from the dashboard. The tool never places, modifies or closes any trade.

products.name: Visual RR Panel
products.shortDescription: Plan a trade on the chart: drag entry, stop loss and take profit lines and see lot size, risk, reward, RR and margin update live, then place the order with one click.
overview: Visual RR Panel lets you plan a trade the way you think about it: on the chart. Click NEW LONG or NEW SHORT and three lines appear, ENTRY, STOP LOSS and TAKE PROFIT, with shaded risk and reward zones. Drag any line and the panel instantly recalculates lot size, money at risk, potential reward, risk/reward ratio, the cost of the spread and the margin required.

Position sizing works from a percentage of equity or from a fixed lot. You can lock the RR so the take profit follows your stop loss, start from an ATR-based stop distance, flip the direction, snap the entry to the market price and show a 1R marker. A CHECKS section warns you about problems before you trade: RR below your minimum, risk above your limit, a spread that is too large for the stop, a stop on the wrong side of the entry or too close to the market.
When the plan is ready, one click places a market order, or a limit or stop order depending on where you put the entry line. The tool never trades on its own; every order needs your click.

products.name: Volume Profile Panel
products.shortDescription: Volume profile with POC, Value Area, high / low volume nodes and previous-period levels for the day, week, month, last N bars or visible range.
overview: Volume Profile Panel draws a histogram of traded volume by price directly on your chart, showing where the market accepted price and where it moved through quickly. You can build the profile for the current day, the previous day, the week, the month, the last N bars or the visible chart range, and switch modes with one button.

The tool marks the Point of Control (POC), the Value Area High and Low (VAH / VAL, 70% by default) and, if you turn them on, high volume nodes (HVN) and low volume nodes (LVN) that often act as support, resistance or fast-move zones. Previous-period POC, VAH and VAL levels are projected forward as reference lines. The histogram can be anchored to the right edge of the chart or to the start of the period, and its width is adjustable.

The statistics section tells you whether price is above, below or inside the value area, its distance from the POC, the number of price rows, the volume above and below the current price and the nearest HVN and LVN. It uses real volume when your broker provides it and tick volume otherwise. Optional alerts fire when price crosses the POC, VAH or VAL. The tool is for analysis only and never trades.
